name: Density
description: Mass for volume; affects freight, ship weight and shielding.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Bond Strength
description: How strongly constituents are held together; affects thermal behaviour, heat resistance and refining energy.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Reactivity
description: Degree of chemical interaction and dangerous combination potential.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Electrical Conductivity
description: Ability to carry electricity; relevant to wiring, motors, generators, batteries and electronics.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Thermal Conductivity
description: Ability to transfer heat; relevant to radiators, heat exchangers, cooling and insulation.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Toughness
description: Resistance to cracking, impact, vibration and shock failure.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Energy Content
description: Useful stored energy; drives fuels, combustibles, explosives and propellants.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Purity
description: Useful material fraction relative to waste or impurities.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Toxicity
description: Hazard to colonists, crops, animals and biological systems.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Corrosiveness
description: Hazard to equipment, pipes, pumps, tanks, vehicles, machines and structures.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Nuclear Stability
description: Nuclear safety/stability; low values represent radioactive behaviour.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Viscosity
description: Resistance of a liquid to flow; affects pumping and liquid handling.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: State
description: Physical state classification such as solid, liquid, gas or molten.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Magnetic Potential
description: Magnetic usefulness of ores, refined metals and alloys.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Organic Origin
description: Identifies plant, biomass, wood and fibre origins.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Crystal Structure
description: Identifies crystalline and optical/sensor-relevant structure.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Salinity / Ion Content
description: Dissolved salt and ionic content of aqueous materials.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Acidity
description: Acidic strength classification.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Alkalinity
description: Alkaline strength classification.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Breathability
description: Suitability of a gas mixture for life support.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Oxidizer Strength
description: Oxidizing potential relevant to combustion and propulsion.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Rarity
description: Occurrence rarity used for survey/progression language.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Volatility
description: Tendency to vaporise or behave as a volatile material.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Flammability
description: Combustion propensity of fuels, biomass, oils and propellants.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules

name: Explosiveness
description: Potential for unstable or explosive energetic behaviour.
sourceSection: Appendix A — Designer truth: property vocabulary and derivation rules
